info.name: Find the Crumpled Piece of Paper Again

descriptions.notStarted: You have lost the list of informants you retrieved from the hut in the swamp region. What to do...? Let's go see #bJM#k again.
descriptions.inProgress: JM scowls and clicks his tongue at you. He says he'll provide you with the list of informants again, but asks you to pay #ba fee of  2000 Mesos#k and instructs you to leave it inside the trash can. Let's head over to #b#m107000300##k.
descriptions.completed: You have taken the list of informants out and left 2000 Mesos inside the trash can.
